high_level_description: This image is a stylized graphic that combines elements of finance and international relations, specifically focusing on the economic power of the United States and China. Background: The background features the flags of the United States and China. The American flag is prominently displayed with its stars and stripes, while the Chinese flag is partially visible behind it, showing its red color and yellow stars. The flags are set against a dark, almost black backdrop, which makes them stand out more vividly.
